name: Elematic — Addons for Elementor
author: Anwar Hossain

sections.description:
Elematic is a lightweight Elementor addon packed with modern UI elements for creative websites. Designed for speed, flexibility, and clean output.

Whether you’re a designer, freelancer, or agency, Elematic provides essential animated widgets to build beautiful layouts with ease.

🔥 Key Highlights

  • Built for performance (no unnecessary scripts)
  • Modern UI and clean markup
  • Works with Elementor Free & Pro
  • Responsive and SEO friendly
  • Growing widget library

Included Widgets

  • Accordion
  • Animated Heading
  • Animated Shape
  • Button
  • Chart
  • Circle Info
  • Circle Progress Bar
  • Circle Text
  • Countdown
  • Counter
  • Dual Button
  • Gallery with Filter and Popup / Lightbox
  • Grid with Image Popup / Lightbox
  • Highlight Text
  • Icon Box
  • Image Animate
  • Image Slide
  • Info Link
  • Lottie
  • Marquee
  • Post Grid with Load more pagination
  • Progress Bar
  • Service List

More widgets will be added in future releases.

Features

  • Works with Elementor Free and Pro
  • Minimal script loading — only loads assets for active widgets
  • Fully translation ready
  • Compatible with caching and optimization plugins
  • Google Pagespeed Lighthouse 100% for optimization, accessibility, performance, and SEO.

Translation

This plugin is translation-ready and includes a .pot file.

Credits

Developed by Anwar Hossain
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/elematic-addons-for-elementor/ or install via Plugins > Add New
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress
  3. Open any Elementor page and start using “Elematic” widgets in the panel
sections.faq:
Does it work with Elementor Free?

Yes. All widgets are compatible with Elementor Free and do not require Pro.

Will it slow down my website?

No. Elematic is optimized for performance and includes only essential assets.

Can I use it with other Elementor addons?

Absolutely! Elematic is compatible with all major Elementor addon packs.

Does it support Lottie animations?

Yes. A dedicated Lottie widget is included.

Does your post widget support Load More button to load new post without reaload page?

Yes. A Post Grid widget is included.
